narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative cover: Pandora treated as a specimen on a naturalist's plate, capturing the book's whole stance at a glance.
subject: A single glowing blue-green Pandoran frond laid flat at the center of a dark slate examination plate, held down by two thin pale specimen pins crossed near its stem. The frond's veins glow faintly with cyan bioluminescence. To one side rests a round brass-rimmed magnifying lens on a small stand, angled over the leaf so a soft circle of magnified glow shows through it.
scene: A dark naturalist's examination table seen from directly above, almost empty, with a faint scatter of luminous spores around the frond and a shallow pool of teal light cast by the leaf onto the slate.
camera: Top-down flat-lay view looking straight down at the plate, the frond and lens arranged like a museum specimen sheet.
light: The brightest light is the leaf itself glowing from within; cool low ambient elsewhere; a soft bloom where the magnifier concentrates the glow.
palette: Near-black slate, deep indigo shadow, cyan and teal leaf glow, a single restrained warm amber glint on the brass lens rim.
style: Painterly naturalist field-plate illustration, observed-from-life, textured.
detail_level: High detail on the frond veins, pins, and lens rim; soft falloff into dark negative space around them.
composition: Frond centered and isolated with generous dark negative space; the magnifier in the lower third on a rule-of-thirds point.
consistency_notes: A single luminous cyan-teal frond on dark slate, warm amber only on the brass lens; this calm specimen-plate look anchors the prologue's other bench scene.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no readable writing, no logos, no people, no cartoon or anime style, no oversaturation
